newsitem.title: USA: Mobil says Green Canyon out 2-3 months.
newsitem.headline: Mobil says Green Canyon out 2-3 months.

text.p: Mobil Corp said Wednesday that its Green Canyon 18 oil platform platform could be down for between two and three months after a fire there on December 10.
The platform produces around 21,800 barrels per day (bpd) of oil and 43 million cubic feet per day of natural gas. The oil is pumped through the Texaco-operated Eugene Island gathering facility.
"All production from Green Canyon is halted," said Chris Springham, a spokesman for Mobil. He said the company still did not know the cause of the fire, which is pending an investigation.

Though the extent of damage was still not know, there were some repairs such as recabling of melted electric works which would mean the platform would not be operational for some time, Springham said.
The Green Canyon field produces sour crude and feeds into the Eugene Island system, which produces 30 degree (API) sour crude.
